description: Docker builds (§19 M2.9, P1): `npm run build:artifacts` runs `docker build --target artifacts -o build/artifacts .`; the artifacts stage copies dist/ from the build stage, which COPYs package.json, src/ and assets/ (filtered by .dockerignore). build/ is gitignored and loaded by a test; the oracle never runs docker, so the test affected through the image is declared with expect_affected.

mutations.name: copy-source
mutations.description: edit a file COPY src brings into the build stage

mutations.name: copy-source-assets
mutations.description: edit a file of another COPY'd directory

mutations.name: copy-source-added
mutations.description: add a file to a COPY'd directory (membership)

mutations.name: dockerfile-edit
mutations.description: the Dockerfile is a config of the image

mutations.name: dockerignore-edit
mutations.description: un-ignore assets/drafts: the build context changes

mutations.name: dockerignored-file
mutations.description: control: src/NOTES.md matches **/*.md in .dockerignore, so the image does not change

mutations.name: dockerignored-dir
mutations.description: control: assets/drafts is ignored as a directory

mutations.name: lib-edit
mutations.description: control: a file outside every COPY source
